title_zh: 为神学参访确认礼拜观察边界

scenario.label_zh: 为神学参访确认礼拜观察边界
scenario.goal_zh: 区分课程参访与参加礼拜并约定按接待人员提示安静观察

context_zh: 虚构神学课程学生联系一处愿意接待参访的宗教场所，只讨论参访礼仪与自主选择，不评价信仰优劣。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Ivo
sentences.text: Our theology class is visiting on Friday. Are we expected to join the worship?

sentences.speaker: Ms Hart
sentences.text: No. You're welcome to observe from the rear seats, but participation is entirely your choice.

sentences.speaker: Ivo
sentences.text: Thank you. We want to learn without getting in anyone's way.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hart
sentences.text: That's welcome. We value tolerance here, so visitors don't have to share our beliefs. Please save questions for the conversation afterwards.

sentences.speaker: Ivo
sentences.text: Of course. We'll sit where you direct us and keep our questions until the end.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hart
sentences.text: I'll meet your group at the entrance and show you the seats.
